from_date.description: Older day, YYYY-MM-DD. null if EPSS history is too short to start the window; total is then 0.

to_date.description: Newer day, YYYY-MM-DD. null only if EPSS history is empty; from_date is then null too.

window_note.description: Present only when from_date is null: a fixed sentence that the EPSS history cannot start the window yet.

total.description: CVEs that rose over the window and match the filters, before paging.

limit.description: Most items in results: the limit argument, 20 by default.

offset.description: Items skipped: the offset argument, 0 by default.

next_offset.description: offset plus this page's items; total on the last page.

product_filter_note.description: Present only with a vendor or product filter: such a filter can miss CVEs.

epss_delta.description: epss_score less epss_previous_score, 0-1. Always above 0: a CVE is listed only when its score rose.

epss_percentile.description: Share of all scored CVEs whose EPSS score on to_date is the same or lower, 0-1.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
